statements.status_notes: docker/docker is a transitive Go dependency of the falco container plugin's go-worker, used solely as a client of the local docker.sock to read metadata of already-running containers; the plugin runs no daemon and handles no registry or build inputs.

The vulnerable daemon path is not reachable from this image.

grafana/alloy v1.16.1 imports github.com/docker/docker v28.5.2+incompatible via the legacy pre-rebrand path. The upstream fix lives in github.com/moby/moby/v2 (post-rebrand module split); no higher version exists on the legacy docker/docker import path. A bump requires alloy upstream to migrate its import paths to moby/v2. Reachability of the docker cp archive-extraction code path in alloy's runtime (container metadata and log discovery only) is pending assessment.
